title: Ronin Bridge exploit (March 2022) — historical case
summary: On 2022-03-23 an attacker using compromised Ronin validator keys withdrew ETH and USDC from the Ronin Bridge contract on Ethereum to 0x098B…2f96, then split funds across new wallets and routed a portion into Tornado Cash. OFAC added the receiving address to the Lazarus Group SDN entry on 2022-04-14. This dataset is a recording of real, public Blockscout/GoPlus/GitHub API responses replayed through the same TRACEFUSE pipeline.
collection_method: scripts/collect_historical_case.py runs the live pipeline against keyless public APIs with a recording HTTP transport; every recorded response is the unmodified provider body with its retrieval timestamp. Credentials are never recorded.
known_gaps: Bounded traversal (3 hops, 6 branches/node, 5000 records/address): not every downstream wallet is included.
Tornado Cash pools break deterministic linkage; withdrawals are not traced.
Later laundering steps (e.g. bridging to other chains after May 2022) are outside the time window.
Explorer labels and GoPlus flags reflect the providers' state at recording time, not at the time of the incident.

sources.title: OFAC Recent Actions 2022-04-14: North Korea Designation Update
sources.summary: Updates the LAZARUS GROUP SDN entry to add 'Digital Currency Address - ETH 0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96'.
caveats: A sanctions designation attributes the address to an SDN entry under U.S. law; it is not a technical proof of key control.

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Sanctions Notorious Virtual Currency Mixer Tornado Cash (press release jy0916)
sources.summary: States Tornado Cash was used to launder over $455 million stolen by the Lazarus Group in the largest known virtual currency heist to date.
caveats: Does not list individual transactions; links the heist to Tornado Cash at the aggregate level. Tornado Cash was delisted on 2025-03-21.

sources.title: Ronin Network - REKT
sources.summary: Independent incident write-up: compromised validator keys used to withdraw 173,600 ETH and 25.5M USDC from the Ronin bridge.
caveats: Secondary reporting; not an official statement.
